Author: Kagekazu
Name: RelicTracker
Punchline: Track relic progress and materials across inventory and retainers.
Description: Track relic weapon, tool, and armor progress across every job. Owned relic detection and live material counts from Allagan Tools (replicas included). Optional FFXIV Collect sync for relics you no longer have.
Changelog:
- Copy a Tracker Buy list (Need amounts) to the clipboard for pasting into Knightshopper's shopping list.
- Tracker now groups what's left by what you do: Buy, Craft, Gather & fish, Farm in content, One-time steps, and Activities. Prefer the old layout? Switch "Group by" to "Relic step".
- Buy missing materials with Knightshopper: one button per currency (gil, tomestones, scrips, GC seals, and more). In Knightshopper, enable both IPC permission switches and add RelicTracker to the allowed plugins.
- More Artisan craft lists: Lucis, Resplendent, Zodiac, Anima, each job's A Relic Reborn weapon, and the Phantom weapon one-time crafts. Needs a newer Artisan; the buttons appear once your Artisan has the lists.
- Lucis tools: after your first crafter or gatherer Lucis, the rest of that category can be bought from a Calamity Salvager for 1,000 gil. The Tracker counts materials only for the job you pick as your first Lucis.
- New materials: gatherer and crafter items for Supra and Lucis, each job's A Relic Reborn weapon and materia, and the one-time steps for Resistance and Phantom weapons.
- Materials shared by several crafters or steps are now counted correctly, and items you own are only counted once.
- Step notes rewritten as short numbered steps with tips, instead of a wall of text.
- Relic tab shows where each material comes from, wraps long names, and lists the jobs still to do once a job is finished.
- Cleaner look: one Overview table, calmer progress and shortfall colours, and a single Integrations list in Settings.
- Item names show in your game's language.
